title: Stronger staged evidence collection
details: Property Maintenance repair tasks now break useful process evidence into clear stages instead of relying on one weak final image
Every evidence stage can use either a photo or a video while keeping Evia's existing learner UI
Photos now lead straight to a required written explanation
Videos record camera and microphone together and guide the learner through prompts without stopping the recording
Each video prompt change is timestamped and stored with the evidence, with optional extra written text afterwards
Photo and video capture use a large 1:1 working area and unfinished media is kept locally so the learner can return to it
summary: Evia v127 strengthens practical evidence while preserving the existing Evia interface and one-stage-at-a-time learner flow.
changes: Added staged evidence for key Property Maintenance repair tasks
Added required explanations after photo evidence
Added guided continuous video recording with audio prompts and timestamps
Added optional extra text after video evidence
Added local draft persistence and resume for unfinished evidence
Added square 1:1 photo and video capture surfaces
Moved Evia's offline evidence cache to v127
